title: TateConjecture: Lean 4 Structural Specification of the Tate Conjecture for Galois-Invariant Etale Cycle Classes
description: Standalone Lean 4 structural specification (`TateConjecture/Basic.lean`) and comparative documentation (`docs/STATEMENT.md`, `docs/KNOWN_CASES.md`, `docs/COMPARISON.md`) of the Tate Conjecture relating Galois-invariant l-adic etale cohomology classes in H^{2r}_et(X_{k^s}, Q_l(r))^{Gal(k^s/k)} to Q_l-linear combinations of algebraic cycles on smooth projective varieties over finitely generated fields. Formalizes the type-theoretic statement skeleton of the Tate Conjecture in Lean 4. Explicitly states that neither the Tate Conjecture nor the Hodge Conjecture is proved here.
